# winrt-Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Interop

Lets a visually hosted WebView2 take the files dropped on its window, as an OLE drop target.

This package provides the `winrt.microsoft.web.webview2.interop` module.

It is built against version 1.0.4314.35 of the `Microsoft.Web.WebView2`
NuGet package.

```
pip install winrt-Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Interop
```

installs it with `winrt-Microsoft.Web.WebView2`.
